compound_or_probe: ISRIB as a probe (trans-1,4-cyclohexanediylbis[2-(4-chlorophenoxy)acetamide], CHEMBL4303573, from identity_isrib_20261108); not a candidate
action: eIF2B activator that binds the beta-delta interface and stabilises the decamer; offsets phospho-eIF2 inhibition; does not stop eIF2alpha phosphorylation
context: WWOX-deficient human neural cells and their isogenic corrected cells; the use is to tell the phospho-eIF2alpha route from a GSK3-site route
hypothesised_benefit: none claimed; the probe gives information, it is not assumed to rescue
wwox_starting_observation: none for ISRIB or eIF2B in a WWOX system; the ISR modulator card records a fly Atf4 signal only with Wwox reduction plus amyloid, and a lower ISR target set in one human knockout transcriptome (exploratory); GSK3 observations in WWOX exist (E01, E02, E03, E04) but concern GSK3, not the eIF2B chain
external_precedent: EI13; EI16; EI10; EI21; EI04; EI05; EI27; EI25; EI22
inferred_steps: (1) phospho-eIF2alpha is the brake in WWOX cells; (2) if not, a GSK3-site brake exists; (3) a probe response separates (1) from (2) only if the engagement control works and phospho-eIF2alpha is measured
identity_and_action: identity: shared full InChIKey of the unnamed ChEMBL record and the FDA-SRS record named ISRIB, trans by the registry title; action: binding at the beta-delta interface of the complex (level 1), not at epsilon; effect on translation is pharmacodynamic
comparator: GSK3 inhibitors (lithium G01 only as labelled non-specific; second chemotype not qualified)
main_counterevidence: ISRIB shows an effect at basal state in some sources (EI11, Zyryanova 2018 discussion) and none in others (EI15, EI26); neurons: ATF4 did not follow in rat cortical cultures (EI22); no benefit in one toxic-protein model (EI23)
result_that_would_weaken_it: phospho-eIF2alpha not raised and ISRIB with working engagement control gives full translation restoration (then ISRIB acts by a route not described in the sources read)
next_experiment: design.tsv steps 0 and 1 with the concentration series
consequence_for_existing_investigation: the existing probe_links row and the ISR modulator card gain the rule that every ISRIB arm needs a phospho-eIF2alpha readout, an engagement control and a translation readout, and that ISRIB little is not a refutation (grid G06, G07, G10)

wwox_starting_observation: lithium is the only GSK3 comparator the module qualifies (card G01, REQUIRES_QUALIFICATION, seizure score equal in controls, E03); GSK3 phospho-Ser9 falls in null brain at one time point on one lane per genotype (E01, E02)
inferred_steps: abstain: a second chemotype (candidates named in hypotheses H1) has no card and no source in the module showing dephosphorylation of the epsilon serine; a card would be a rewritten description of existing candidates, not a qualification
result_that_would_weaken_it: a card could be written when a second chemotype has a documented epsilon-site or translation readout in a neuronal system
next_experiment: design.tsv step 2 names the comparators as arms only
consequence_for_existing_investigation: none; G01 remains the module record; no change proposed
